lines.text: Believers are to detest evil, cling to what is good, and be devoted to one another in brotherly love.
Believers are to keep their spiritual fervor, be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, and persistent in fasting.
Believers are to share with saints in need, bless those who persecute them, and weep with those who weep.
Believers must not repay evil for evil, must live at peace with everyone if possible, and must leave room for God's wrath.
Feeding a hungry enemy heaps ashes on his head, and believers overcome evil with good.
